content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Richmond

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma plus five years. Review PMI's official requirements against your background, then contact Granite PM Academy to verify your qualifications before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp. Our instructor-led course delivers the full required education online, on a schedule designed for working professionals. Attend sessions from anywhere, ask questions in real time, and receive course materials and recordings for review.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the bootcamp, submit your formal application to PMI, including proof of education and experience. Pay the PMI exam fee at the time of application. Granite PM Academy will guide you through the submission process and required documentation.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor support—to solidify your knowledge. Schedule your PMP exam through PMI's testing partner. Our team remains available to answer final questions before you test.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP is valid for three years. During each renewal cycle, earn professional development units (PDUs) through training, volunteering, or work experience. Plan ahead to meet renewal deadlines and keep your credential active and recognized across your career.
